second_live_read.row_identification: integer first table cell as reco_id; 3x3 and Roux are recognized only when exact cell texts are present in the same row
second_live_read.post_freeze_fresh_membership: reco_id absent from the complete frozen G4 baseline ID set
second_live_read.preexisting_unseen_membership: reco_id present in baseline, 3x3, Roux, and absent from every R1.13-development reco_id

preexisting_unseen.selection: deterministic SHA256(R114PRE:reco_id) order over all eligible baseline-present unseen 3x3 Roux index rows

post_freeze_fresh.selection: all live-index rows with reco_id absent baseline and exact 3x3 + Roux cells

detail_fetch.raw_route: alg.cubing.net link containing setup and alg query parameters

external_ontology.operator: exact frozen G4 raw-state operator; external routes are scored by a runtime copy differing only in input-loader plumbing and the already-recorded single helper typo repair

external_null_scoring.reference_features: frozen G4 canonical development feature ledger from reference seal
external_null_scoring.feature_p: add-one upper tail against full frozen reference features at the first available hierarchy level
external_null_scoring.attempt_statistic: max -log10(feature_p) within each external canonical route
external_null_scoring.familywise_reference: frozen G4 LOO reference attempt-statistic bank
external_null_scoring.familywise_p: add-one upper tail of external attempt statistic against all finite frozen reference attempt statistics

preexisting_unseen_transport_gates.note: PASS supports ontology transport only, never authority.
